## Question

Continue our discussion of exact Frobenius counterterms plus proper residual integrals. Full result is now constructed: 346 original rows, 84 amplitudes (one known), normalized joint-analytic DE after removing both coalescing apparent poles, z^5 jet, eps0..11, 6757 surviving proper integrals; 91 local solutions actually rewritten into 83 unknown series / 565 Laurent coefficients. Shared compressed fixed-point connection11.1MB. Generic Jordan chains and saturation retained.

Numerical issue: prepared B0 is strictly lower triangular but entries have poles up to z^-5. Remainder E_i=O(z^{r_i} log^k z), r_i=N+1+g_i>=1 (some r_i=2 etc). Stored proper-integral recursion E_{k,i}=Integral_0^z(sum B_qij E_{k-q,j} - D_ki). We use gamma(t)=z[t^8+i/4*t^8*(1-t^8)] and ordinary Gauss collocation, interpolation of earlier F_j(t) with only F_j(0)=0. At80-digit arithmetic, numerical cancellation/uncertainty is enormous; testing250digits now. Suspect collocation interpolants do not preserve each remainder's higher vanishing powers, which high-pole B magnifies at very small t.

Please critically recommend a minimal mathematically sound fix, suitable general code. Options: factor E_i=t^{8r_i} H_i(t), store weighted Volterra definitions H_i(s)=s^{-w_i} integral_0^s t^{w_i}g_i(t)dt, and quadrature/interpolation tailored to regular H_i with correct powers; or avoid evaluating near singular endpoint by explicit high-order Frobenius evaluation at a small positive ordinary point + finite residual path from there (but cannot replace exact symbolic endpoint solution by a truncated approximation in stored result). Can ordinary unweighted proper definitions stay as mathematical output while only the numerical reader uses proven endpoint factors? Need account epsilon0 diagonal generated by factoring, logs, and coefficientwise higher-pole constraints. Do not propose simply raising precision if it does not fix interpolation error. We do not need full AMFlow precision now, but evaluator must actually converge on these stored exact expressions. Give a concrete algorithm and checks. Existing repo https://github.com/congyuezhang/factorization-and-loops may not include latest uncommitted code; mathematical details here authoritative.
